description: Replaces the ENTIRE text of a shape or table cell: one atomic batch of deleteText(ALL) + insertText. If the target has no text yet the delete is skipped automatically, so it works on empty placeholders too. An empty text just clears the object. Replacing text drops per-character styling — restyle with update_text_style afterwards if needed. For a table cell pass row_index + column_index together.

object_id.description: The shape or table object id (from list_slides).

presentation_id.description: The presentation id — the long id from the URL (docs.google.com/presentation/d/<presentationId>/edit) or from create_presentation output.

text.description: The new full text; empty string clears the object. \n starts a new paragraph.

name: set_text
title: Set (replace) text
